designationHistory.indexText: Establishment of the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 6920—Establishment of the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, September 18, 1996

review.note: Proclamation 6920, 61 FR 50223, signed 1996-09-18; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President.

designationHistory.indexText: Modifying the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9682—Modifying the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, December 04, 2017

review.note: Proclamation 9682, 82 FR 58089, signed 2017-12-04; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Reduced the monument by about 860,000 acres (as recited in Proclamation 11044).

designationHistory.indexText: Restored the monument's boundaries (Proclamation 10286) to about 1.87 million acres, its extent before the 2017 reduction

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 10286—Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, October 08, 2021

review.note: Proclamation 10286, 86 FR 57335, signed 2021-10-08; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Title names the monument only; operative text restores the lands reserved as of Dec. 3, 2017, about 1.87 million acres.

designationHistory.indexText: Modifying the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 11044—Modifying the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, July 13, 2026

review.note: Proclamation 11044, 91 FR 45179, signed 2026-07-13; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Post-cutoff proclamation verified on federalregister.gov and govinfo (published July 17, 2026): reduced the monument to about 181,541 acres in two units (Canyons and Escalante; Kaiparowits Horizon). Note the proclamation text itself misprints "9862" for 9682.
